title: Panasonic — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Panasonic.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Innovation for Life." Panasonic pioneered the inverter microwave — a technology that delivers consistent power instead of cycling on and off. This means even heating, proper defrosting, and no hot/cold spots. Their countertop and built-in microwaves are considered the best in the industry by many professional chefs.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Anyone buying a quality microwave. Customers who value cooking results over brand name.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Panasonic:

• Inverter technology delivers consistent power — no hot spots or cold centers

• Best microwave defrosting in the industry — even, thorough thawing

• Genius Sensor auto-adjusts power and time based on food humidity

• Compact flat-bottom designs maximize interior space

• The microwave professional chefs actually recommend
